title: Make the main prompt and Yes-celebration Chocolate Day themed (copy + illustration)

requirements.text: Update the Question screen user-facing text so the main prompt is Chocolate Day themed (not Valentine themed) and asks the user to accept the Chocolate Day wish. The Question screen must continue to show exactly two options: “Yes” and “No”.

quotes: The page should be ... chocolate day ... to ask her to be Happy Chocolate Day, my dear cutie 🍫💖 ... There should be two options: Yes or No.

acceptanceCriteria: On the Question screen, the headline no longer says “Will you be my Valentine?” and is replaced with Chocolate Day themed copy.
Only two buttons are shown on the Question screen, labeled exactly “Yes” and “No” (case-sensitive).
The Cover and Note screens remain unchanged in flow and still precede the Question screen.

requirements.text: Update the Celebration screen shown after clicking “Yes” to display a Chocolate Day themed message and the Chocolate Day illustration (boy wishing a girl Happy Chocolate Day while proposing on one knee), instead of the current Valentine “Good choice” meme content.

quotes: When she clicks Yes, show her boy is sweetly wishing a girl Happy Chocolate Day.”
Happy Chocolate Day, my dear cutie 🍫💖 ... All the best—focus well and give your best paper.
Description (scene): A boy is wishing a girl Happy chocolate Day while proposing to her, kneeling down on one knee.

acceptanceCriteria: Clicking “Yes” transitions to a Celebration screen that includes the text “Happy Chocolate Day, my dear cutie 🍫💖” (exact characters).
The Celebration screen includes the additional sentence “All the best—focus well and give your best paper.” (exact punctuation/dash).

The Celebration screen displays the existing Chocolate Day illustration from the frontend static assets (no backend fetch) and no longer displays /assets/generated/valentine-good-choice-meme.dim_1024x1024.png.
The “No” button behavior and all other screen transitions still work as before.

constraints: Do not modify any files under frontend/src/components/ui or other paths listed in frontend.immutablePaths.
Keep the app frontend-only for assets (images/audio must be served from frontend/public; do not fetch images/audio from the backend).
Backend (backend/main.mo) remains unchanged unless strictly required.
nonGoals: Changing the Cover screen name (it should remain “Sayli”).
Changing the Note screen text or illustration (it should remain the current Chocolate Day note and illustration).
Adding new authentication or any backend data persistence.
